title: Cost anomaly detection
description: Continuously monitors spending patterns to detect unusual spikes or drops that may indicate misconfigurations, runaway resources, or billing errors.
example_prompt: "Analyze the cost data for the last 7 days across all subscriptions. Identify any resource or service where daily cost deviates more than 20% from the 30-day rolling average. Provide the resource ID, cost delta, and likely root cause."
